subject: Fiscal Year 2025 Preliminary Budget Priorities
overview: The committee met to review and aggregate individual budget recommendations for the upcoming fiscal year. Councilors focused on school funding, competitive staffing salaries, and the modernization of city financial and payroll systems.

items.title: Budget Process and Schedule
items.summary: President Bears outlined the timeline for the fiscal year 2025 budget process, which includes submitting collective council recommendations to the mayor followed by department head meetings from April to May.

items.title: Individual Councilor Budget Recommendations
items.summary: Councilors presented priorities including level-funding schools and libraries, retaining grant-funded personnel in health and planning, and increasing salaries for the City Solicitor and election staff to improve recruitment. Other requests included funding for road and sidewalk improvements, tree planting, and the establishment of Youth and Gender Equity Commissions.

items.title: Financial and Operational Infrastructure
items.summary: The committee discussed the necessity of investing in updated financial and payroll software to replace manual, paper-based systems and improve financial transparency and reporting efficiency.

items.title: Aggregation of Recommendations
items.summary: Approved a motion to aggregate individual councilor recommendations into a prioritized list for final review on March 19 before submission to the mayor.
